description: Lists the workspace's Tasks — sentence-orchestrated processes — with their sentence, status, and recent runs (id, status, who a waiting run is on). Use this to find a task the user names ('claims intake') and to see what's in flight; workbench_tasks_get reads one in full.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_tasks_list
title: List Workbench Tasks
